reviews.summary: A large Core Contributors HYPE release is widely scheduled for December 6, 2026—about 20 days away—creating a near-term supply-overhang risk. No directly verified HYPE-specific exploit, outage, or regulatory action surfaced in the fresh search.
materialRisks: Scheduled Core Contributors release on December 6, 2026: trackers estimate roughly 8.6M–9.92M HYPE (about 1% of total supply), with estimates near $574M–$671M at current prices. The amount discrepancy adds schedule uncertainty. ([coingecko.com](https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/hyperliquid?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: The previous modeled monthly contributor release occurred November 6, 2026; the next is modeled for December 6, 2026. ([faro.io](https://www.faro.io/data/hype?utm_source=openai))

Hyperliquid does not publish a complete official future HYPE release calendar, so third-party timing and quantity should be treated as estimates rather than a confirmed protocol announcement. ([hypebasis.io](https://hypebasis.io/hype-unlocks?utm_source=openai))
The market symbol is strongly identifiable as Hyperliquid's HYPE token, though the signal does not identify the EUR trading venue, preventing venue-specific maintenance/listing checks.
